name: self-secret
description: Lets a session run a command with a secret it never sees: the person pastes it into a form on this machine (127.0.0.1), it is checked before anything runs, handed to the one command in an environment variable, and masked in everything the command prints; a hold keeps it for later commands. The local paste of secret-run.

updateCheck.title: Update check
updateCheck.description: on: when a tool of this plugin is called and the last check is 30 minutes old, fetch this plugin's published plugin.json from GitHub (a plain GET of a public file) and say when a newer version is out. off: never check.
